name: CategoryTheory.Functor.const_obj_obj
initialProofState:
J : Type u₁
inst✝¹ : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J
C : Type u₂
inst✝ : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} C
X : C
x✝ : J
⊢ Eq (((CategoryTheory.Functor.const J).obj X).obj x✝) X
decl:
/-- The functor sending `X : C` to the constant functor `J ⥤ C` sending everything to `X`.
-/
@[simps]
def const : C ⥤ J ⥤ C where
  obj X :=
    { obj := fun _ => X
      map := fun _ => 𝟙 X }
  map f := { app := fun _ => f }

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.constComp_hom_app
initialProofState:
J : Type u₁
inst✝² : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J
C : Type u₂
inst✝¹ : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} C
D : Type u₃
inst✝ : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₃, u₃} D
X : C
F : CategoryTheory.Functor C D
x✝ : J
⊢ Eq ((CategoryTheory.Functor.constComp J X F).hom.app x✝) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id ((((CategoryTheory.Functor.const J).obj X).comp F).obj x✝))
decl:
/-- These are actually equal, of course, but not definitionally equal
  (the equality requires F.map (𝟙 _) = 𝟙 _). A natural isomorphism is
  more convenient than an equality between functors (compare id_to_iso). -/
@[simps]
def constComp (X : C) (F : C ⥤ D) : (const J).obj X ⋙ F ≅ (const J).obj (F.obj X) where
  hom := { app := fun _ => 𝟙 _ }
  inv := { app := fun _ => 𝟙 _ }

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.instFaithfulConstOfNonempty
initialProofState:
J : Type u₁
inst✝² : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} J
C : Type u₂
inst✝¹ : CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} C
inst✝ : Nonempty J
⊢ (CategoryTheory.Functor.const J).Faithful
decl:
/-- If `J` is nonempty, then the constant functor over `J` is faithful. -/
instance [Nonempty J] : Faithful (const J : C ⥤ J ⥤ C) where
  map_injective e := NatTrans.congr_app e (Classical.arbitrary J)

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.compConstIso_inv_app_app
initialProofState:

⊢ Eq (((CategoryTheory.Functor.compConstIso J F).inv.app X✝).app X) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (F.obj X✝))
decl:
/-- The canonical isomorphism
`F ⋙ Functor.const J ≅ Functor.const F ⋙ (whiskeringRight J _ _).obj L`. -/
@[simps!]
def compConstIso (F : C ⥤ D) :
    F ⋙ Functor.const J ≅ Functor.const J ⋙ (whiskeringRight J C D).obj F :=
  NatIso.ofComponents
    (fun X => NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ => Iso.refl _) (by aesop_cat))
    (by aesop_cat)
